name: @nicotind/capacitor-apk-update
description: Sideloaded-APK self-update: downloads a NicotinD release APK from GitHub and hands it to the system package installer (the Android/TV app has no store channel). Android-only by construction (no ios src). There is no JS package to import — the web app reaches it through the injected Capacitor.Plugins.NicotindApkUpdate global (see packages/web services/update.service.ts).
